name: Savannah Lion Tusk
summary: In the Barrens, Savannah Lion Tusks go from hunting trophies to ingredients in Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale.

sections.title: A Curious Brewing Ingredient
sections.body: The great cats roaming the Barrens carry sharp, heavy tusks. Prowlers, huntresses, prides ruled by patriarchs, and beasts like Humar the Pridelord all bear them. Travelers often take the teeth as proof of a successful hunt. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet uses the tusks with plainstrider kidneys and thunder lizard horns to recreate Chen Stormstout's famous namesake brew, a potent ale with a legendary kick few mortal gullets can withstand.

faq.q: Why does Brewmaster Drohn need Savannah Lion Tusks?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet needs the tusks to recreate Chen Stormstout's namesake brew. His mentor passed the recipe down to him, and the tusks are one of three Barrens ingredients needed to reproduce the stout's distinct flavor and kick.

faq.q: Which beasts carry Savannah Lion Tusks?
faq.answer: Savannah lion pride members across the Barrens carry the tusks. They include Savannah Highmanes, Patriarchs, Matriarchs, Huntresses, Prowlers, and rare beasts like Dishu and Humar the Pridelord.

aliases: why are lion teeth called tusks
faq.answer: Savannah big cats have oversized canine fangs that grow prominent and thick in Kalimdor's rugged wilds. Local hunters and frontiersmen call them tusks.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking the fierce prides across the Barrens tests your skill. Their dangerous fangs can prove deadly in battle and valuable to local brewers.
